Title: Homepage loads and displays featured car content
Preconditions: Browser available; stable internet connection; no prior session required
Steps: 1. Open https://www.nexaexperience.com/ in a desktop browser (Chrome recommended). 2. Wait for the page to finish loading. 3. Observe the hero/banner and main content area. 4. Verify the page title and primary headings are displayed.
Expected Result: Homepage loads without error. URL is nexaexperience.com. Featured car content is visible (e.g. hero banner with Explore Now / featured model). Main landmark content is rendered. No blank page or unhandled error.
Notes: Verified via automation — 18/18 suite pass

Title: Cars mega-menu exposes NEXA model links
Preconditions: User is on NEXA homepage
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.nexaexperience.com/. 2. Hover or click the Cars menu item in the header. 3. Observe the expanded menu panel. 4. Note all visible model links (e.g. FRONX Baleno Grand Vitara XL6 Jimny Invicto e VITARA).
Expected Result: Cars menu opens without error. Multiple car model links are displayed with navigable href paths. Menu is usable without page crash.
Notes: 8 model links found in DOM after Cars menu open

Title: Navigation exposes car category labels
Preconditions: User is on NEXA homepage
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.nexaexperience.com/. 2. Open the Cars mega-menu. 3. Scan menu labels and grouping for category terms (Hatchback Sedan SUV Hybrid or equivalent groupings).
Expected Result: Car category or segment labels are present in navigation structure. User can identify model families without submitting any form.
Notes: Cars menu shows model names grouped by segment (Hatchback/SUV etc.) — structural nav labels confirmed on live site

Title: Clicking a car model navigates to model detail page
Preconditions: User is on NEXA homepage
Steps: 1. Open the Cars mega-menu. 2. Click a model link (e.g. FRONX). 3. Wait for navigation to complete. 4. Note the browser URL and page content.
Expected Result: User is navigated to the correct model detail URL (e.g. /fronx). Model page loads without error. Browser does not remain on homepage.
Notes: Navigated to /fronx successfully

Title: Model detail page displays model name and starting price
Preconditions: User can access a model detail page
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.nexaexperience.com/fronx (or any current NEXA model URL). 2. Wait for page load. 3. Locate model name/hero heading. 4. Locate starting price or price indicator (₹ / LAKH / from).
Expected Result: Model name or hero title is visible. Starting price or price-related text is visible on the page. No broken layout on primary content area.
Notes: Visible price text found on model page

Title: Model detail page displays key specs or variants
Preconditions: User is on a model detail page
Steps: 1. Open a model detail page (e.g. /fronx). 2. Scroll through the page. 3. Locate specifications variants mileage engine features or similar technical content sections.
Expected Result: Key specs variants or feature sections are present and readable. Content is structurally complete (sections load; not empty placeholder only).
Notes: Specs/variants section visible on model page

Title: Build Your Own / Configurator link is present and navigable (read-only)
Preconditions: User is on a model detail page
Steps: 1. Open a model detail page. 2. Locate Build Your Own or Configurator link/button. 3. Click the link (do not complete or submit configuration). 4. Observe resulting page or modal.
Expected Result: Build Your Own / Configurator entry point is visible. Click navigates to configurator or related page without site error. No lead/booking form is submitted as part of this test.
Notes: Link visible; automation verifies presence not full navigation submit

Title: Invalid model URL shows graceful fallback
Preconditions: Browser available
Steps: 1. Navigate directly to https://www.nexaexperience.com/nonexistent-car-xyz-999. 2. Wait for page response. 3. Observe whether a 404/not-found page appears or user is redirected.
Expected Result: Page does not show a raw server error or broken blank screen. Site shows 404/not-found messaging OR redirects to a valid NEXA page. User can continue browsing.
Notes: Invalid URL handled — page loads without server error

Title: Homepage loads within acceptable time budget
Preconditions: Browser cache cleared or hard refresh available
Steps: 1. Clear cache or use hard refresh. 2. Navigate to https://www.nexaexperience.com/. 3. Measure time until main content and hero are visible (target: under 60 seconds; ideal: under 10 seconds on normal broadband).
Expected Result: Homepage becomes interactive without hard timeout. Primary content appears within acceptable time. No perpetual loading spinner blocking the page.
Notes: Homepage loaded in ~1.5–2s in automation run

Title: Help Me Select entry visible on homepage (read-only check)
Preconditions: User is on NEXA homepage
Steps: 1. Navigate to homepage. 2. Locate Help Me Select or Discover Your Perfect Car section. 3. Confirm quiz entry link is present (do not complete quiz if out of scope).
Expected Result: Help Me Select or equivalent quiz entry is visible on homepage. Link is clickable. No action beyond visibility check required for AC1 scope boundary.
Notes: Help Me Select / Discover Your Perfect Car entry visible on homepage — read-only visibility confirmed

Title: Locate Nearest Showroom section visible on homepage
Preconditions: User is on NEXA homepage
Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.nexaexperience.com/. 2. Scroll to Locate Your Nearest NEXA Showroom section. 3. Observe section heading and supporting text.
Expected Result: Showroom locator section is visible on homepage. Section communicates dealer/showroom discovery intent. No page error when scrolling to section.
Notes: Showroom heading + Explore Nearby Showrooms visible after scroll

Title: Explore Nearby Showrooms entry navigates to dealer locator
Preconditions: User is on NEXA homepage
Steps: 1. Scroll to Locate Your Nearest NEXA Showroom section. 2. Click Explore Nearby Showrooms (or equivalent CTA). 3. Wait for navigation.
Expected Result: User reaches dealer/showroom locator experience (e.g. /connect-to-dealer). Locator page or map view loads without error.
Notes: Explore Nearby Showrooms CTA from homepage section navigates to dealer locator — confirmed on live site

Title: Dealer search by valid city returns results
Preconditions: User is on dealer locator page (https://www.nexaexperience.com/connect-to-dealer)
Steps: 1. Open dealer locator page. 2. Select CITY tab if present. 3. Enter a valid Indian city (e.g. Mumbai Delhi Bangalore). 4. Select matching suggestion if autocomplete appears. 5. Submit search.
Expected Result: Search executes without crash. Results area updates. Message indicates showrooms found (e.g. found N NEXA showroom). At least one result row/card is displayed.
Notes: Mumbai city search returned showroom results

Title: Dealer search by valid pincode returns results
Preconditions: User is on dealer locator page
Steps: 1. Open dealer locator page. 2. Select PINCODE tab if present. 3. Enter a valid pincode for a major city (e.g. 400001 for Mumbai). 4. Submit search.
Expected Result: Search completes without error. Dealer/showroom results are displayed. Result count is greater than zero for a well-served pincode.
Notes: Pincode 400001 on PINCODE tab returned showroom results with distance text — matches CITY search behavior

Title: Dealer results include distance and address information
Preconditions: User has performed a successful city or pincode search with results
Steps: 1. Perform valid dealer search (e.g. city Mumbai). 2. Inspect each result card/row. 3. Verify distance indicator (Km Away or similar) and address/dealer name fields are present.
Expected Result: Each result shows structural dealer information: name or label plus distance and/or address text. Results are readable and consistently formatted.
Notes: Showroom results + Navigate controls verified

Title: Search with remote location shows not-enough-dealers or zero results
Preconditions: User is on dealer locator page
Steps: 1. Open dealer locator. 2. Enter a remote or obscure location/pincode unlikely to have nearby showrooms within default radius (e.g. remote island pincode or fabricated location). 3. Submit search. 4. Observe empty-state messaging.
Expected Result: Site shows not enough dealers found empty state OR zero showroom results OR validation indicating no dealers in radius. Page does not crash or hang. User can attempt a new search.
Notes: Invalid pincode did not crash; production may show default dealers instead of strict empty state — document if manual differs

Title: Empty city search handled gracefully
Preconditions: User is on dealer locator CITY search mode
Steps: 1. Open dealer locator. 2. Select CITY tab. 3. Leave city field empty. 4. Submit search (Enter or Search button).
Expected Result: No browser crash or unhandled error. Validation message may appear OR page retains locator with default/previous state. User remains on NEXA site and can retry.
Notes: Empty search handled without crash

Title: Empty pincode search handled gracefully
Preconditions: User is on dealer locator PINCODE search mode
Steps: 1. Open dealer locator. 2. Select PINCODE tab. 3. Leave pincode field empty. 4. Submit search.
Expected Result: No crash or white screen. Validation or inline guidance may appear. Locator page remains functional for subsequent input.
Notes: Empty PINCODE submit — no crash; page stays on locator; same graceful handling as empty CITY search

Title: Dealer result Navigate control is present
Preconditions: User has valid dealer search results displayed
Steps: 1. Perform successful dealer search. 2. Inspect result cards. 3. Locate Navigate link or button on one or more results.
Expected Result: Navigate control is visible on dealer result entries. Control is clearly associated with a specific showroom result.
Notes: Navigate controls present on results

Title: Dealer Navigate control opens map or valid target
Preconditions: User has dealer results with Navigate control visible
Steps: 1. Perform successful dealer search. 2. Click Navigate on first result (read-only: do not submit contact forms). 3. Observe new tab/window or map behavior.
Expected Result: Navigate opens Google Maps map URL or equivalent navigation target OR triggers in-page map behavior. No site error. No unintended lead/contact form submission.
Notes: Automation verifies href/enabled state; manual click-to-map behavior recommended for full confirmation
